_README: Every number the localization model depends on lives here, with its provenance marked. 'sourced' means taken from a cited public document. 'estimate' means a judgement call with a stated range, and the model runs sensitivity over that range rather than pretending to a point answer. Change a value here and re-run; nothing is hardcoded downstream.

decomposition._source: Derived in decompose_price.py from Tesla's public pricing API, 18 overdetermined observations, R-squared 1.000000

china_lfp_cell_usd_per_kwh.note: BNEF and tender data for 2025-26 put utility LFP cells roughly in the 55-78 USD/kWh band, with outlier stationary-storage transactions as low as 36. Central case set at 60; sensitivity runs the full band.

us_cost_uplift_multiple.note: US LFP cell manufacturing cost relative to mature Chinese production: higher labour, immature domestic precursor supply, lower yields during ramp. No authoritative public figure exists; this is the single softest assumption in the model and is treated as such.

section_301_rate_pct.note: Raised from 7.5% to 25% on lithium-ion non-EV (storage) batteries effective 1 January 2026.

general_tariff_rate_pct.note: Standard duty on lithium-ion battery imports, stacking with Section 301 for a combined 28.4%.

ocean_freight_usd_per_kwh.note: China-to-US-West-Coast container freight allocated per kWh of cell. Varies with rate cycle.

credit_45x_cell_usd_per_kwh.note: Section 45X advanced manufacturing production credit for battery cells.

credit_45x_module_usd_per_kwh.note: Section 45X credit for battery modules. Stacks with the cell credit when both steps are domestic.

credit_45x_phase_down.note: Share of full credit value by production year.

itc_rate_pct.note: Section 48E investment tax credit base rate, the credit a storage project puts at risk if it fails FEOC material-assistance thresholds.

feoc.note: Prohibited Foreign Entity rules enacted 4 July 2025 under OBBBA; Treasury Notice 2026-15 (12 Feb 2026) gave operational guidance. Applies to projects beginning construction in 2026 or later. Storage projects must meet a Material Assistance Cost Ratio - a minimum share of material value from non-prohibited sources - which ratchets upward annually.
feoc.macr_note: Threshold shown is the required non-prohibited share of material value. Reported as 60% for 2026 rising 5-10 points per year; the upper path is modelled as +5/yr and flagged as uncertain.

us_capex_usd_per_kwh_annual_capacity.note: Greenfield LFP cell plant capex per kWh of annual nameplate output.
